title: Paraty → Gru → Bogotá → Cartagena
companions: All four until GRU; then Sahil + Priyesh + Amisha
intro: One hard travel day buys back an entire Colombian day.
anchor: All four leave Paraty together; Niki home; the trio connect straight through Bogotá to Cartagena.
morning: Leave Paraty ~07:00 by private transfer. Build a large GRU traffic buffer.
Do not split the group simply to gain another hour in Paraty.
evening: Wingo P5 7520 BOG→CTG is currently scheduled Monday 00:05→01:38.
Pre-arrange Cartagena transfer; expect hotel around 02:15-02:30.
logistics: Book the Cartagena hotel from 11 Oct and warn them of the after-midnight arrival.
Treat AV184→Wingo as separate-ticket risk unless a protected booking structure is found. Hand luggage only materially helps.
watchOut: 2h35 scheduled connection is workable but not luxurious. Recheck Wingo check-in/gate cut-offs and AV184 punctuality before purchase.
sleep: Cartagena - room reserved from 11 Oct despite after-midnight arrival.

title: Cartagena
intro: Wake up in the Caribbean instead of spending the holiday cycling Bogotá.
anchor: Walls / old city at human pace → pool reset → Getsemaní after dark.
morning: Sleep after the 02:00 arrival; do not force a 07:00 start.
Late breakfast and a compact old-city / walls walk before heat peaks.
afternoon: Late-afternoon Getsemaní murals, street life and music.
evening: Plaza de la Trinidad / Getsemaní energy.
Street food, rum, live music; keep Celele for tomorrow.
eat: Arepa de huevo, tropical fruit, coconut rice, limonada de coco.
logistics: The old Bogotá full day is gone. This is the payoff: a true first Cartagena day.
sleep: Cartagena - Movich / Casa Don Luis / Ananda.

title: Cartagena
intro: Market floor to one of Latin America’s best restaurants to live salsa.
anchor: Bazurto Market with a guide → Celele → salsa.
morning: Guided Bazurto food/culture visit - do not do Bazurto independently.
Eat through the market rather than treating it as a photo stop.
afternoon: Hotel pool / air conditioning 14:00-16:30. This is strategic.
evening: After: live salsa (Café Havana or best current programme).
eat: Market fruit / snacks at lunch; Celele is the flagship dinner.
logistics: Use a vetted local guide for Bazurto.
watchOut: Midday heat is punishing; protect the reset block so the night stays good.

title: Cartagena → Medellín
intro: One last Caribbean half-day, then Colombia changes climate and rhythm by dinner.
anchor: Final Cartagena morning + Medellín arrival + local salsa night.
morning: Slow breakfast. Castillo San Felipe early if you want the historic anchor; otherwise enjoy the old city.
afternoon: Target direct CTG→MDE around 17:25; exact flight to reconfirm.
evening: Check in. Son Havana / Laureles-style salsa environment.
Join a class if it runs; bottle-service Poblado is not the objective.
logistics: MDE airport is outside the city; allow transfer time.
sleep: Medellín - Landmark / Patio del Mundo / Elcielo.
places: Castillo San Felipe de Barajas Cartagena

title: Guatapé / Medellín
intro: Climb a giant rock above a reservoir, then come back for a different city night.
anchor: Piedra del Peñol + Guatapé by small/private vehicle + reservoir boat.
morning: Leave early. Climb Piedra del Peñol before peak crowds.
afternoon: Boat on reservoir. Antioquian lunch. Walk Guatapé zócalos / colourful streets.
evening: Return Medellín. If salsa clicked, go deeper; otherwise switch to contemporary music/bar energy.
eat: Bandeja paisa / grilled Antioquian food; aguardiente in moderation.

title: Medellín → Bogotá
intro: Understand the city vertically, then leave late rather than donating daylight to an airport.
anchor: Metro + Metrocable + community-led urban story, with almost a full day before Bogotá.
morning: Coffee at a strong local roaster.
afternoon: Community-led neighbourhood / urban-transformation tour. Choose provider carefully.
evening: Hotel and sleep; Bogotá is now a finale, not a destination block.
logistics: MDE airport transfer can be 45-75+ min; leave enough buffer.
watchOut: If a neighbourhood tour feels extractive or voyeuristic, skip it.
sleep: Bogotá - Four Seasons Casa Medina / HAB / Casa Legado.

title: Bogotá
intro: Taste the capital hard and fast, then leave without airport panic.
anchor: Early Monserrate + compact coffee/Candelaria + final Colombian lunch.
morning: Early Monserrate for the city-and-mountain view.
Descend for a compact Candelaria / specialty-coffee hit if queues and traffic cooperate.
afternoon: Final lunch: ajiaco or contemporary Colombian close to the route; no long tasting menu.
Return hotel, bags. Priyesh & Amisha leave for BOG ~14:00 for 17:15 flight.
logistics: Bogotá traffic can erase an hour instantly. Protect the airport buffer.
watchOut: Do not schedule Monserrate late. The point is a concentrated taste, not squeezing in a full Bogotá itinerary.
